origins.guarantee: Every covered operation preserves the exact named safety property.
origins.subject: exact final admitted module, complete actions and Safety policies
origins.interpretation: A conditional universal program theorem; it does not assert which operations actually ran.
origins.justification: Q7/Q10 and FR preservation/completeness obligations expressly require generic and concrete checking.

origins.guarantee: Property holds at the exact full incoming state/history boundary.
origins.subject: full HistoryRef, module and complete policy set
origins.interpretation: A validated snapshot establishes one boundary, not its past; a fresh segment cannot certify earlier states.
origins.justification: The activation protocol requires full incoming validity and exact enforced boundary.

origins.guarantee: Only approved, checked operations run throughout the named segment.
origins.beneficiary: deployment operator and safety relying parties
origins.subject: exact active module/policies and interval
origins.interpretation: Host enforcement is an external obligation; the certificate cannot prevent a bypass handle.
origins.justification: The source explicitly names host eligibility and continuity; its validator does not implement the whole protocol.

origins.guarantee: Complete original observations and each committed step have exact Core meaning.
origins.subject: accepted origin through exact expected HistoryRef and ordered outputs
premises: trusted Core semantics/implementation or justified checker
origins.interpretation: Correct history precedes succinct proof proposals. Equal final state, state validity, or a digest alone cannot replace exact step checking.
origins.scope: Core 031/032 investigation requirements; correct history remains fixed in 034
origins.justification: FR014/016 and the common transition contract demand exact observations/history; source chronology does not establish original user intent.

origins.guarantee: Untrusted exported safety evidence is independently checked for the exact program.
origins.subject: exact module, policies, action/operation inventory, theorem roots
origins.interpretation: The new consumer checks a mathematical claim about every covered permitted operation; no execution-history replay or constant-time history verifier is implied.
origins.justification: Consumer verification reconstructs and validates evidence and coverage independently of producer success.

origins.guarantee: A new receiver verifies a real initialized executed prefix without trusting prior producer acceptance.
origins.subject: exact initial anchor, endpoint, modules and ordered results
origins.interpretation: This is a separate executed-history requirement introduced explicitly in the later Core experiments. The available sources do not show that Safety logically required it as a product contract.
origins.justification: 032 US3 and 033 US2 state this distinct recipient claim; no causal user-instruction archive is available.

origins.guarantee: The new history recipient establishes the prefix without historical Core decision replay.
origins.subject: complete initialized prefix under 033 semantics
origins.interpretation: 033 forbids full historical replay as its proof-chain substitute. This restriction differs from Safety fresh Lean kernel replay, which is required rather than prohibited.
origins.scope: Core 033 experiment only; product adoption unresolved
origins.justification: The explicit no-replay wording applies to executed Core history, not to all uses of the word verification.

origins.guarantee: Certified success waits for finished proof/compression/independent check; committed success also waits for durable publication.
origins.beneficiary: caller relying on certified committed success
origins.subject: exact current transition and prefix with durable publication
origins.interpretation: 032 compares synchronous and asynchronous contracts. 033 selects a synchronous experimental contract. That selection is not evidence of current product approval.
origins.scope: Core 033 experiment only; product adoption unresolved
origins.justification: FR012/013 distinguish certified and committed success, while 032 FR012 calls them separate operational guarantees.

origins.guarantee: 033 complete local certified durable transition p50<=50ms/p95<=100ms; fresh recipient p95<=100ms.
origins.lifecycle: complete local commit and fresh independent verification
origins.subject: 033 full exact certified/durable endpoints
origins.interpretation: These are explicit proposed experiment acceptance budgets, not observed results or universal Safety certification budgets. Three 034 observations cannot establish these percentiles.
origins.scope: Core 033 acceptance targets; no new 034 product promise
origins.justification: SC007/008 name endpoints and percentiles and exclude native-only component timings.

origins.guarantee: Program construction and independent proof rechecking have separate whole-chain cold usability budgets.
origins.subject: Safety 511 declared reference conditions
origins.interpretation: Program certification may happen at admission rather than every runtime operation. Its cost contract cannot silently become the 033 per-transition budget.
origins.justification: Q3/Q6 and FR015/016 separate cold-role budgets and actual installation/OS conditions.

origins.guarantee: Reuse inherited validity and an accumulated execution proof to avoid rechecking old work.
origins.subject: proposed semantic kernel and proof chain
premises: full checker/circuit correspondence remains to be proved
origins.interpretation: The architecture is a candidate technique for satisfying stronger history checking. Its recommendation is not proof of feasibility or origin of the user requirement.
origins.justification: Source is an architecture proposal; later 033 tests are evidence about its selected implementation, not adoption.

attribution_limit: Pinned repository documents establish their written requirements. They do not establish the causal origin of the user intent. This investigation request authorizes research, not a product trust/finality change.
